idea-plugin.name: CRA Annex II User Docs Lint
idea-plugin.description:
19 rules over the user documentation that ships with your product: support-period end date, vulnerability reporting contact, EU declaration of conformity address, secure decommissioning.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CRA Annex II User Docs Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cra-annex-ii-docs-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cra-annex-ii-docs-lint

action.text: CRA Annex II User Docs Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run CRA Annex II User Docs Lint on the file in the editor
